ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) receive regarding the jinns listening to the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Jinn (72:1) reveals that a group of jinns listened to the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) reciting the Qur'an in Mecca, marking a unique instance of non-human beings receiving divine guidance. Shia scholars often highlight this event as evidence of the Qur'an's universal scope and the Prophet's role as a mercy to all worlds, including the unseen realm. The 'wonder' (ajaban) they expressed underscores the transformative power of the divine message, which led to their immediate submission and return to their people as warners.

en.ahmedali: that a number of jinns had listened
; then said: 'We have heard the wondrous Qur'an,
en.ahmedraza: Proclaim (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), “I have received the divine revelation
to my recitation, so they said, ‘We have heard a unique Qur’an.’
en.arberry: Say: 'It has been revealed to me
that a company of the jinn gave ear
, then they said, "We have indeed heard a Koran wonderful,
en.daryabadi: : it hath been revealed Unto me that a company of the Jinn listened
, and said, verily we have listened to a Recitation wondrous.
en.hilali: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "It has been revealed to me
that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinns listened (to this Quran).
They said: 'Verily! We have heard a wonderful Recital (this Quran)!
en.itani: that a band of jinn listened in

en.maududi: Say, (O Prophet), it was revealed to me

and then (went back to their people) and said:
